archetypes.name: dyn-hook-identity
archetypes.rationale: Changed clone identity precedence and fail-safe paths in two hooks.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the marker-local CLONE_PATH precedence in both hook scripts. Check that known-foreign markers are skipped only when identity is canonical and that unknown identity remains fail-safe. Pay special attention to Monitor/TaskOutput and bare-dir Bash paths. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
